d: Long, straight charcoal-grey hair with blunt bangs and deep reddish-purple gradients at the tips flows down the back, paired with large, round, vibrant lime-green eyes. The face has a youthful, childlike maturity and a petite, slender build. The outfit consists of a white long-sleeved blouse with a blue sailor collar and necktie, a short pleated blue skirt with a white trim, and a white sailor cap adorned with a blue bow and a circular metallic emblem. Signature details include white gloves with blue ruffled cuffs and mechanical grey armored plating strapped to the legs.
